title: Please help!!!!!
author: Uncle___Marty
selftext:
Ok, not me. I'm serious though. I REALLY would appreciate it if you read this, i'll keep it short but it benefits EVERYONE here.

I see people releasing their games on playstore and steam and stuff and while the posts get upvotes, and there are comments I found I'm doing something that others here arent? Literally a day ago someone posted their finished game on playstore and there were upvotes and comments but nobody actually seemed to download and review this persons game (and it was a COOL game!).

What I want to ask everyone is : if you see games released here, PLEASE download and review them. When you get to this point I bet you'll be begging for people to do this. So c'mon. We're all using AI in the best way we can to make dreams come true, lets help each other out!

My game is a LONG way off being finished, and while im making it im learning from others here and enjoying reading others experiences. When I finally finish it I'd hope people could do the same for me as I keep doing for others. Lets ALL help each other out, and honestly, we all benefit from it.

comments.author: ScallionZestyclose16
comments.body:
I’ll download it if I like it.
If it’s an obvious clone of a game that they’ve copied and the difference in the game is ”just trust me you’ll see it when you play it”.. Then nah :)

comments.author: watchingsuits
comments.body: No one deserves my time simply because they posted on Reddit. If their game looks good, it will get people. Pity reviews and pity ratings are useless. And not everybody who posta on here took the time and effort to ensure their game is good. some are  just looking for a quick cash grab.

comments.author: LocoMod
comments.body:
Do this because you have a passion for it, not to get anyone's attention. The world will reward quality. You will not need to ask for it. Proceed under the understanding that you are not owed anything and the most precious thing in the entire world is time. So when you demand it from others, understand what you're asking for.

That is all.

comments.author: Traditional-Win6821
comments.body:
I don't know if you can ask something like that. Just understand that i going to be hard to be seen. I launch my game, is not great, i think I have 100 downloads since saturday, and I dont belive it going to reach 300 if i don't money on promotion.

But i was ready for that, i actually want to learn about this promotion part to set my future project plan.

replies.author: Uncle___Marty
replies.body:
Happy to try your game and leave a review. fingers crossed it might help you a little. for promotion theres actually a TON you can do. Ask a recent frontier model on how you can expose your game and your jaw will drop, its easy(ish) to do a bunch of things to promote your game. I just feel that this sub is dedicated to making games with AI and there are SO many people that will see AI on their projects and get 1 star/trash reviews and thats not fair. People here could be supporting each other a little to try and help, and hell, if their game is shit then it wont go anywhere, but if its good it could help it reach a better status.

Purely good intentions and suggestions for a community with the same goals to help each other out in a TINY TINY way. These days? tiny can me a LOT though....

Good luck with your game broski :) if you want to share the game with me in reply or private then feel free.

replies.author: Traditional-Win6821
replies.body:
I think that you can create a game, is never just a prompt, but a lot of wisdom in this community 

Now, marketing, promotion... that is something to learn, and is hard. The you try mine and i try yours, don't think will work in the long run. And you need to take the comments, accept then... lots of comments that didnt see your work and put out "AI slop"... hard to read.

So, learn, read, see how other posts, what communities are there... and so own.
